model.method: L2 logistic regression; full-batch gradient descent; intercept not penalised

dimensions.weights: linear ordinal disagreement |a-b|/2; categories fixed at 1,2,3
linear ordinal disagreement |a-b|/2; categories fixed at 1,2,3
linear ordinal disagreement |a-b|/2; categories fixed at 1,2,3
linear ordinal disagreement |a-b|/2; categories fixed at 1,2,3

totals.model: ICC(A,1): two-way absolute agreement, single rating; fixed selected pair; no generalisation to all raters

reliability.scope: Each dimension is analysed across cases; dimensions are not pooled as independent people. Null is missing, not zero. Negative coefficients are retained. No automatic pass.

content.scope: Relevance 1-4; 3/4 counts as relevant. Expert opinion is one source of content evidence, not a validity percentage or proof of predictive performance. Missing reviews are reported.

rasch.method: regularised joint Rasch toy fit; theta centred; fixed discrimination 1; research rehearsal only

report.scope: Synthetic workflow and arithmetic rehearsal. Not validity, real outcome prediction, scale permission, or production CAT.
